title: NYC weather forecast: Brisk and chilly | AccuWeather - ABC7 New York

NYC weather forecast Nov. 15: Brisk and chilly | AccuWeather - ABC7 New York 
 24/7 Live New York City New Jersey Long Island Northern Suburbs Connecticut Weather 
 AccuWeather: Brisk and chilly Sunday in NYC, milder week ahead 
 AccuWeather forecast for NYC, New York, New Jersey and Connecticut 
 By Eyewitness News 
 The Loop: Your live look at weather and traffic NEW YORK (WABC) -- Sunday looks brighter with lighter winds and temperatures in the upper 40s.
 A longer stretch of dry weather is expected next week. Temperatures will gradually moderate, reaching the mid-50s by Tuesday and climbing back to around 60 degrees by the second half of the week.
